card.name: Remove contact lenses before instillation
card.fires_on: The word right before 'before' or 'prior to' in instructions to take out contact lenses before eye drops, mainly 'removed' or 'lenses'. It also fires on a similar slot in other pre-treatment checks.

modes.label: Contact lens removal
modes.description: The verb or noun in 'remove contact lenses' or 'lenses should be removed' just before 'prior to' instillation.
modes.example: Contact lenses should be<< removed>> before applying OXERVATE and may

modes.label: Other pre-treatment steps
modes.description: The end of a requirement phrase before 'prior to' starting treatment, such as verifying pregnancy status.
modes.example: Verify pregnancy status of females of reproductive<< potential>> prior to initiating CYTALUX treatment

card.writes: It promotes 'before' and 'prior to' style words, predicting that a time-ordering word comes next.
card.plain: It fires when a label says to do something, like removing contact lenses, ahead of the next step, so 'before' comes next.
